svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 12/12 The Arcades (Common)
svg.desc: Brick arches between classes. The afternoon sun lays their shadows down the walkway. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
